note: Official Swiss statistics the simulated world is calibrated to or checked against. 'use' says how.

unemployment_rate.definition: searching non-workers under 65 / (workers + searchers). SECO counts registered unemployed only, so the ILO rate is higher; the band spans both.

median_unemployment_months.definition: median spell of searching before an accepted job; 199 days = 6.5 months
median_unemployment_months.source: BFS labour force survey (SAKE), median duration of unemployment 199 days, Q4 2025

bachelor_to_master_within_24m.use: calibrate the preference for a master's
bachelor_to_master_within_24m.definition: share of university bachelor graduates who start a master's within two years
bachelor_to_master_within_24m.source: BFS data cited by Avenir Suisse (2024): about 87%; BFS Bologna barometer: 88% average since 2004

master_to_phd_within_24m.definition: share of master graduates who start a PhD within two years
master_to_phd_within_24m.source: ASSUMPTION: no verified BFS figure found; replace with the BFS transitions table when available

moving_rate_per_year.definition: share of people who move home in a year

graduate_unemployment_1y_master.source: BFS graduate survey, UH master graduates one year after their degree (ILO), 2025: 6.4%

graduate_unemployment_1y_bachelor.source: BFS graduate survey, FH bachelor graduates one year after their degree (ILO), 2025: 4.9%

vacancy_rate_dwellings.use: context: explains why flat applications often fail
